claims.statement: NodeViewToggle is a StereoModeToggle-style 80x36 two-segment gallery|node control (kViewTiles / kViewNodes icons, help key nodeViewToggle, setNodeView + onToggle callbacks) inserted LEFT of the preset bar in PluginHeader; the header seeds it from services_.prefs.getBool(UiPrefs::kNodeView, false) at construction.

The view choice persists as a plain UiPrefs key UiPrefs::kNodeView = "t3k.nodeView" (UiPrefs.h:68; stored as "true"/"false" strings, default false = gallery): PluginRoot::onNodeViewToggle writes prefs.setBool(kNodeView, nodeView) and calls main_.chainScreen().setView(nodeView).

ChainScreen grows a third view branch: setView(bool) hides the gallery and shows the node view (and back); the node view has NO DragScroller — ChainScreen::scroller() keeps returning gallery_.scroller() even while the node view is visible; closeDetail() restores whichever view nodeView_ says the user was in.
The node-view ticket added Help keys + entries: nodeViewToggle, nodeView, nodeEmptySlot, node, nodePower, nodeRemove, nodeMode.

The node view is a second, TOGGLEABLE views layer over the same ChainState the gallery draws (ticket ui-block-interface-draft.md): no new DSP — a slot's contents ARE the existing ChainBlocks re-arranged in ChainState lane order, and every mutation goes back through ChainStore so gallery and node view can never disagree. The old 4x3 snake grid (kColumns=4/kRows=3, 84x60 cells, Grid::slotNearest drops) was replaced 2026-10-15 by the signal-line grid.

The grid is ONE row of 10 slots (Row::kSlotCount = 10, Row::kLabelH = 18 label band under each square, NodeModel.h:34-36); a SECOND row of 10 appears only when the lane exceeds 10 blocks (NodeView::paint/resized compute nCells = 10 + (lane.size() > 10 ? 10 : 0)) so lanes of 10 or fewer render a single row. Cell i = lane item i (1:1 left-lane map); tail cells beyond the lane are EMPTY = a valid bypassed pass-through state (the key difference from the gallery, where every tile is an effect).

Persistence: UiPrefs::kNodeView = "t3k.nodeView" (UiPrefs.h:68) is a plain STRING pref "true"/"false" — UiPrefs::getBool accepts only those two spellings, anything else (including JUCE var::toString()'s "1") falls back to the default false. ChainScreen's ctor reads it and calls setView(true) when set; PluginRoot::onNodeViewToggle (fired by the PluginHeader NodeViewToggle, an 80x36 two-segment gallery|node control, help key nodeViewToggle) writes the pref and forwards to chainScreen().setView(nodeView). ChainScreen::setView hides the gallery / shows the node view; the node view has no DragScroller.

Repaint invariants (bug found in the 2026-10-15 capture hunt — the line stayed invisible for a whole debug session): setNodeView(bool) (NodeView.cpp:629) and chainChanged() (NodeView.cpp:661) both END WITH repaint(), because refresh() only updates the cell children; the body (signal line segments, In/Out labels, strip) must repaint on first-time activation, on lane row gain/loss, and on selection change or the line silently stays absent until an unrelated invalidate. Line numbers are as of the m06828 batch (commit 72f48ea); the law is unchanged.

Grid drag-and-drop (m06828 batch, commit 72f48ea, superseding the 6df21a2 drag-UX closeout): cellDragMove computes the target slot from the GHOST CENTRE (not the raw pointer, which carries the grab offset) with `slot = floor((x - rowX_) / cellW_)` — FLOOR, no half-tile offset — so swap thresholds are SYMMETRIC: crossing ~1 tile left or right targets the neighbour, hovering one's own slot targets it (the old roundToInt(v)=floor(v+0.5) evaluated a slot's own centre k+0.5 and rounded UP: instant right swap while a left swap needed 1.5 tiles, m05941). While the pointer is in the grid the other cells LIVE-REFLOW through the optimistic preview_ lane and a NodeView::DropGlow overlay child (separate from the Ghost, because NodeView's own paint sits UNDER its children) paints a soft halo — rounded-rect wash at 30% alpha + 1.5 px border at 70% in the DRAGGED BLOCK'S OWN border colour (Model::kind colour), centred on the target cell's visible square (m06686: inset x by (slotW - sq)/2) — so the user can see where the effect lands, especially with same-icon effects (m06356/m06359). POSITIONAL LAW (m06828 item 4): a far target beyond the compact lane tail no longer clamps — moveActiveTo splices at `to = jlimit(lead, n, lead + target)` where lead = countLeadingInserts(preview_) (raw list index diverges from grid slot by leading inserts; without this a far drop landed one slot off), and pads preview_ with fresh insert ChainItems (juce::Uuid ids) up to the target first, so dragging to slot 19 with 11 effects lands AT 19. cellDragEnd: an off-grid drop (dragInGrid_ false) CANCELS — cancelDrag() discards the preview, no commit (the ONLY cancel path; a right-click mid-drag no longer cancels, see the pointer-grammar claim, m06828-2); an in-grid drop commits the full-lane id list from preview_ through chain.reorderBlocks with a `>=` size gate (padded id lists are valid commits — reorderChainBlocks materialises the new insert ids), and a drop back on the origin slot is a no-op permutation.

The node grid's read-side model (plugin/ui/views/nodeview/NodeModel.{h,cpp} — a const view over ChainState: kind table with kind colours, paletteKinds, blockAt/indexOf, and orderWith splice) is exercised headlessly by test/src/node_model_tests.cpp (9 tests: kind table, palette, blockAt/indexOf, orderWith permutation invariance, exact-slot move, same-slot no-op, unknown-id untouched, target clamping, empty-square move). Since the m06828 batch (commit 72f48ea) the kind-table test pins the convolution display label "Conv Rev" (was "IR" — the picker menu and right-click menu call it Conv Rev, user m06828 item 1b/3). DspTests compiles the real plugin/ui/views/nodeview/NodeModel.cpp + plugin/ui/model/ChainState.cpp (with plugin/ui and plugin/ui/views/nodeview on the include path) so these tests run the real model, not a copy; the full UI remains unlinked by the suite.

Tone (NAM/conv) nodes in batch 2 behave like their kind, not like empty slots: NodeCell::paint treats `!s.has || s.insert` as the dashed+plus gap state only (hover_ || presetEmpty), so an occupied insert paints its kind-coloured border and icon; NodeCell::update sets the help text to the block's own title when s.has (falling back to help::Key::nodeEmptySlot for true gaps — the old hardcoded 'Empty slot — click to add an effect' with its em-dash mojibake is gone); Model marks insert rows with cs.insert=true and their label as 'add' only while the gap hint shows. Clicking a tone node SELECTS it (strip shows In/Out/Mix), it does not open the add menu (user m02657 item 6).

Testbed scenarios for the node view (scenarios.json, as of the 2026-10-17 bug-batch closeout, commits 0cb035e–22bbaf6): node-main (3-block left lane — compressor selected, chorus, insert — seeds "localStorage": {"t3k.nodeView": "true"}), node-toggle-live (batch 2, click-imitated gallery→node toggle + strip-knob survival), FIVE batch-3 driven scenarios — node-add-gap (add lands in the mid-lane gap, line stays continuous), node-remove, node-knob-change (knob turn + mode menu), node-drag-drop (cell drag & drop), node-switch-view (gallery↔node switching) — and TWO bug-batch scenarios: node-drag-multi (4-effect lane, four drags including a mid-drag dragStateForShot() "active ghost=true" state assert and an END-lane→cell-9 drop that Model::orderWith clamps to the lane tail) and node-add-far-slot (adding to an empty node far past the lane end; addIntoCell clamps at=jlimit(0,lane.size(),index) so the new block lands at the tail) — all click-imitated, all jassert-pass. Two landmines: (1) the seed value MUST be the string "true" — Host::seedPrefs does prefs.set(name, value.toString()) and a JSON bool becomes "1", which UiPrefs::getBool rejects (the signal line stayed invisible for the whole 2026-10-15 capture hunt until fixed); (2) UiTestbed --capture <outDir> <scenario> writes PNGs (--selftest does not), --capture auto-iterates all scenarios. The drives needed real plumbing: Knob::driveEmit (setValue is face-only; drives need the drag-path emit that fires onChange), Drive::dragTo (multi-point press/travel/release) for the cell drag, and MockBackend add/remove/setParam now mutate the chain so end-state asserts are real.

Cell paint states (the Q-Cortex/Line 6 transparency law, as of batch 3 / 2026-10-17): an ACTIVE block paints an opaque theme::kSurface fill (the signal line STOPS at its edges) with kind-colour border at full alpha and a white icon; a POWER-OFF block paints NO fill (the line runs THROUGH it) with border at 0.35 alpha and a muted icon; an EMPTY slot is invisible by default — a mid-lane gap is a TRUE gap (continuous line, no square) — EXCEPT on mouse hover, where it fills with an OPAQUE theme::kPanelBg panel + dashed border + plus glyph + 'add' label (batch 3: the opaque fill keeps the signal line from showing through the gap square), or when the whole lane is empty/insert-only (CellState.presetEmpty), which shows the same dashed+plus+add hint. A selected block adds a theme::kHighlight border.

Pointer grammar on a node: a short click selects the block (params load into the strip); a 250 ms hold (kHoldMs = 250) begins a lane drag; motion before the hold cancels the timer; right-click opens the block menu (power toggle, help key nodePower; remove, help key nodeRemove; plus the palette add-menu over Model::paletteKinds()) — since the 2026-10-17 bug batch Remove is offered on ALL node kinds including tone (NAM/conv) nodes (cellMenuItems guards only !b->isInsert); since the m06828 batch (commit 72f48ea) the palette add entries are BARE labels ("Delay", "Chorus", "Trem", "Comp", "Rev", "Conv Rev") routed by a CellMenuItem::addKind field (the old "+ "-prefixed label string + paletteKindForLabel reverse-lookup is deleted — the double-plus in the menu), and Model's convolution label is "Conv Rev", not "IR". CANCEL LAW (m06828-2, superseding m05916-3): a right-click WHILE a left-button drag is in flight OPENS THE MENU AND THE DRAG SURVIVES — the mouseDown popup branch no longer cancels; NodeCell::mouseUp ends the drag only on a LEFT release (`if (v_.isDragging()) { if (!g_e2eReleaseButton) v_.cellDragEnd(*this); return; }` — mouseWasClicked(int) does not exist in JUCE 9 and is false on any up, so the e2e handler stamps NodeView::setE2eReleaseButton around the synthetic right mouseUp; real input never sets it). Release off the signal chain is the ONLY cancel (the off-grid preview is discarded by cancelDrag). DOUBLE-CLICK toggles the block's power (NodeCell::mouseDoubleClick -> NodeView::togglePower -> setBlockParam(id, "enabled", 0|1)). Cell hover sets a help text (occupied title, ' (powered off)' suffix when off, nodeEmptySlot key for true gaps) driving the JUCE tooltip and the bottom hint bar via the HintBus HintTracker. Drags use juce::Component::createComponentSnapshot ghosts; since 2026-10-18 (f0b06d4, user m03710) the ghost is a FULL-SIZE OPAQUE clone (setAlpha(1.0f)) at the cell's actual overlay position, created with cell.getLocalBounds() — getBounds() is parent-space and the snapshot clip made it 0×0 for every cell past the first (the m04679/m04723 quarter-ghost/no-ghost bugs) — the OS cursor is NEVER swapped, and the live reflow of the other cells is the drop preview (no cascade clones). A suppress-click-until timestamp keeps a drop from firing a stray select.

The convolution node's strip carries an IR preview: pullConvPreview (NodeView.cpp:1598) pulls chain.convPreview(blockId) (envL/envR arrays + length/sampleRate + fade curves, same pattern as the gallery EffectTile::pullConvPreview) into the strip's KernelPlot (convPlot_, views/gallery/KernelPlot at 64 px). Batch 3 (item 6): with NO kernel loaded (null dynamic object) the preview now setVisible(true) with a cleared envelope + the loaded block's fade curves, so the flat plot + 'Load IR…' button lay out and the strip's knobs are no longer clipped. The 'Load IR…' button (loadIr_) calls startConvIrLoader (NodeView.cpp:1655) which launches an async juce::FileChooser (*.wav;*.wave;*.aiff;*.aif) and on OK calls chain.loadConvIr(blockId, file); a g_irLoaderSeq token guard (plus a convIrChooser_ re-entry guard) drops stale chooser results (WeakReference<Component> is private in JUCE 9, so the loader is token-guarded); an 'error' property on the result is toasted. CLEAR LAW (m06828 item 1, commit 72f48ea): refreshModeLine's non-conv/non-reverb branch now ALSO hides convPlot_/convIr_/loadIr_, so selecting any other kind after a convolution block no longer leaks the kernel's waveform + 'Load IR…' button + IR name/time line onto the new effect's strip (the old code only hid typeB_).

The signal line (NodeView::paint) draws, per VISIBLE row, 2 px white.withAlpha(0.45f) SEGMENTS with a gap around EVERY REAL cell (active AND power-off): an 'In' stub before the first node, ±5 px gaps around each node, an 'Out' stub to the row's right edge. The drawn lane is the OPTIMISTIC preview_ while a drag is in flight (the grid reflows live, m03710) and the native lane otherwise, so the line follows the reflow. EMPTY slots (gaps/inserts, isInsert) are SKIPPED in the per-row occupied-cell list, so the line runs CONTINUOUS through them — a gap only shows its dashed add square on hover, on top of the still-visible line (batch-3 m04252 item 3). Power-off blocks stay in the occupied list: their transparent square lets the line show THROUGH them. The two-row transition is Line 6 stadium style (batch 2, user m02657 — NO snake elbow): row 1's line ends with a 13 px Icon::ArrowRight at the grid's right edge, row 2 starts with a 13 px Icon::ArrowRight at the grid's left edge, both rows flow left→right and row 2 enters its leftmost node. The line is painted before the cells and only when nodeView_ is set (an opaque panel fill before the visibility guard used to cover the inactive gallery view, m03703). DROP-TARGET INDICATION moved off the paint side (2026-10-18 drag-UX closeout): the old in-paint theme::kHighlight border / faded-icon at g_dropTarget is gone; the NodeView::DropGlow overlay child (see the drag claim) is the sole drop-target marker, because NodeView's paint sits UNDER its children and a paint-side ring over an occupied cell was invisible (m06341).

NodeStrip is the selected block's SINGLE-ROW parameter strip docked to the BOTTOM of the view (resized(): stripY = jmax(0, getHeight() - stripH - kStripBottomGap), kStripBottomGap = 16, kStripHeadH = 56; full width). 56 px header: block-kind label in caps over the mode line — context menus: modeB_ (juce::TextButton -> NodeView::openModeMenu(), delay 4 / Compressor 5 / reverb 6 modes) and typeB_ (-> openTypeMenu(), reverb type list, shown only when Reverb::numTypes(mode) > 1); the 2026-10-17 bug batch rebuilt these: items are BARE labels (no leading bullet / check marker, std::nullopt icon), the menu ANCHORS at the invoking button (showStripMenu takes a const juce::Point<int>& anchor; openModeMenu passes modeB_.getLocalBounds().getTopLeft(), openTypeMenu passes typeB_ — the old 'centred over the strip' put the menu offset below), and every item carries a trailing juce::String helpText override so the row tooltip shows a per-mode blurb (static modeBlurb(kind, m) one-liners for delay/comp/reverb + reverbTypeBlurb(mode, t) for the six Digital/Plate/Spring/Small/Chamber/Hall entries, mirroring EffectTile.cpp). A mode pick writes the real param (delayMode/compMode/reverbMode via chain.setBlockParam). KNOB-COUNT LAW (2026-10-17 bug batch): the strip shows the FULL paramsFor(b, false) knob table plus the two reverb signature slots (EffectParams::reverbSigSlot(b, mode, slot), hoisted out of EffectTile's anon namespace so strip and tile pick identical knobs): reverb/conv 12, comp 10, delay/chorus/tremolo 8. kMaxKnobs = 12 and the face AUTO-SHRINKS: syncStrip sets setKnobFace(32) (was kKnobFace) when the visible knob count > 8, so a 12-knob strip fits one row; layoutStripKnobs reads a smaller headPad (2 vs 6) for the shrunk face. In/Out knobs are pinned to the noon readout (m04302) and the Mix/In/Out knobs are IDENTITY-scaled (pos = raw 0..1, knobFromStored only for non-identity scales). Strip visibility: setNodeView(false) hides cells AND strip (strip_->setVisible(false) + clearContent()); syncStrip() hides the strip when no block is selected; the hide_ Icon::X button is shown via updateStripChrome and is the ONLY strip close (hideStrip() clears the selection); the strip stays open while the mouse is inside (knob turns no longer rebuild-and-close it, batch-2 item 9). The POWER button is lit-for-ON (updateStripChrome: b.params.enabled ? theme::kWhite : theme::kMuted — batch 1 had it kHighlight-when-ON, reading as inverted-dim). Per-knob VALUE readout paints persistently above the knob face from KnobScale::format(knobFromStored(*scale, raw)), knob name below (labelOnTop = true); each knob gets setValue(...) after construction (Knob ctor clamps to options.min). Panel: theme::kPanelBg @ 0.55 tinted fill, 10 px radius. Knobs are owned std::vector<Knob*> (created on selection, deleted in clearContent()); onChange writes back through chain.setBlockParam(id, param, knobToStored(...)). Params come from the SHARED paramsFor table in views/gallery/EffectParams.h (tone nodes show only In/Out/Mix trims). Every strip knob is headless-tested by test/src/strip_knob_tests.cpp: 7 StripKnob tests (round-trip + finite readout + numeric readouts ≤4 chars), 8 batch-3 StripKnobPosition tests (identity pos==raw, In/Out noon pin, stored→raw round-trips), and 6 bug-batch StripGalleryParity tests (the strip's visible knob set equals the gallery's signature+full set in BOTH directions + a ≤12 cap).

Grid drag-and-drop (gallery-faithful, as of the m06828 batch, commit 72f48ea — superseding 6df21a2): cellDragMove tracks a dragInGrid_ flag from the ghost centre vs the grid bounds (rowX_±4, row/row-range ±4) and a g_dropTarget slot computed with floor(), not round() — symmetric 1-tile swap thresholds in both directions (m05916-1, m05941). While the pointer is over the grid the other cells LIVE-REFLOW through the optimistic preview_ lane: moveActiveTo erases the active id at `from` and inserts at `insertAt = jlimit(0, n-1, to)` where `to = jlimit(lead, n, lead + target)` (lead = countLeadingInserts(preview_) — with leading inserts a raw list index diverges from the grid slot, the root cause of the one-slot-late far drops); before splicing it lazy-pads preview_ with fresh insert ChainItems (juce::Uuid) up to the target, so a drag to a far slot PADS the lane instead of clamping to the tail (m06828 item 4). The reflow IS the location preview; the NodeView::DropGlow overlay child (rounded-rect wash 30% + 1.5 px border 70% in the dragged block's own kind colour, centred on the target's visible square — m06686) marks WHERE the block will land (m06356/m06359; a paint-side ring was dropped because NodeView paints UNDER its children, m06341). cellDragEnd: an off-grid drop CANCELS — cancelDrag() restores the native lane, no commit (off-chain release is the ONLY cancel, m05916-3 reaffirmed; the former right-click-during-drag cancel was REMOVED in m06828-2 — a right press mid-drag opens the context menu and the drag survives it); an in-grid drop commits the full-lane id list from preview_ through chain.reorderBlocks — the `if (ids.size() >= native.size())` gate (was ==) makes padded id lists legal, and reorderChainBlocks materialises the fresh insert ids. Drops commit through the store; a drop back on the origin slot is a no-op permutation.

Pointer grammar on a node (SUCCEEDED — see the current pointer-grammar claim for the 2026-10-18 law): the 2026-10-17 bug-batch stage of the drag used a light-alpha Procreate-style clone (setAlpha(0.35f)) + setMouseCursor(juce::MouseCursor::DraggingHandCursor) on the ghost, a per-cell drop-slot preview, and a paint-side displacement CASCADE preview via model_.orderWith(draggingId_, g_dropTarget) re-deriving the would-be lane order. All three superseded by the f0b06d4 gallery-faithful law: the ghost is now full-size OPAQUE (setAlpha(1.0f), no cursor swap) and the live grid reflow IS the drop preview; the 2026-10-18 drag-UX closeout added the centered DropGlow target marker and the right-click-during-drag cancel.

Repaint invariants (bug found in the 2026-10-15 capture hunt — the line stayed invisible for a whole debug session): setNodeView(bool) (NodeView.cpp:660) and chainChanged() (NodeView.cpp:692) both END WITH repaint(), because refresh() only updates the cell children; the body (signal line segments, In/Out labels, strip) must repaint on first-time activation, on lane row gain/loss, and on selection change or the line silently stays absent until an unrelated invalidate. Line numbers re-verified after the m06828 batch (commit 72f48ea) and the 2026-10-20 conv settings/export band; the law is unchanged.

The convolution node's strip carries an IR preview: pullConvPreview (NodeView.cpp:1677) pulls chain.convPreview(blockId) (envL/envR arrays + length/sampleRate + fade curves, same pattern as the gallery EffectTile::pullConvPreview) into the strip's KernelPlot (convPlot_). Batch 3 (item 6): with NO kernel loaded the preview shows a cleared envelope + the loaded block's fade curves so the layout holds. The 'Load IR…' button (loadIr_) calls startConvIrLoader (NodeView.cpp:1734) which launches an async juce::FileChooser (*.wav;*.wave;*.aiff;*.aif) and on OK calls chain.loadConvIr(blockId, file); a g_irLoaderSeq token guard (plus a convIrChooser_ re-entry guard) drops stale chooser results; an 'error' property on the result is toasted. CLEAR LAW (m06828 item 1, commit 72f48ea): refreshModeLine's non-conv branch hides convPlot_/convIr_/loadIr_ AND the conv settings chrome, and resets convStripSettings_ = false, so selecting any other kind after a convolution block leaks nothing onto the new strip.

The conv node's strip carries a Settings/Export band (commit 89afb4e, e2e layer b80bca7): settingsToggle_ (a stateful 'Settings' TextButton, mirror of the gallery tile) + settingsExport_ ('Export') + a std::vector<Knob*> of 7 settings knobs (rebuildStripSettingsKnobs: Start/End via scales::convStart()/convEnd(), Pre, F In, F Out, InCrv, OutCrv) written back through chain.setBlockParam. NodeView::setConvStripSettings (NodeView.cpp:1764) is the single owner of the chrome visibility — refreshModeLine keeps the chrome HIDDEN in the face view (a conv selection must not leak the Settings/Export line, the at-rest e2e probe saw 1:0:1); opening hides the waveform + face knobs and shows the 7 settings knobs, closing re-pulls the preview. resized() budgets the band: convBand = convStrip ? (convStripSettings_ ? 152 : 78) : 0 (NodeView.cpp:1125-1127). The Export button calls startConvExportLoader (NodeView.cpp:1861): no IR in the block → guard toast 'No IR loaded in this block' (the e2e-pinned path, since the save dialog can't be driven headless); else a save-mode FileChooser defaulting to <irName>_t3k_48k24/untitled.wav and, on pick, chain.exportConvIr(blockId, dest, 24, 48000). e2e surface: convStripStateForE2E() returns '<toggleVis>:<toggleOn>:<exportVis>:<knobCount>/<visCount>|<toast>|<convIr>' (or 'no-strip'), driven by the node-conv-strip handler in plugin/ui/testbed/NodeViewE2E.cpp and pinned by plugin/ui/testbed/e2e/conv-strip.js (6 checks; its own script because two AppConnections in one process race on socket teardown).
